title: Cached raw derived-section functor
statement: For a scheme S and integer q, define the functor from D⁺(Ab(S_et)) to abelian presheaves on S_et by K↦(U↦Hom(Z[U][0],K[q])). Its map on m:K→L is postcomposition with m[q], and its restriction along a:V→U is precomposition with Z[a][0]. Construct it by shift, additive Yoneda and precomposition with the opposite of freeSheaf followed by singleFunctor. This irreducible concrete functor caches its objects, abelian group structures and maps; no data is selected from a theorem. Conventions and constructions: [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-presheaf].
